messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

We could call the function get_average_monthly_temperature with location="Hawaii" (maybe specify city). For month maybe ask for each month? Actually we just need one month as best. Best time may be April-June or September-November when fewer tourists, good weather. Also consider hurricane risk June-Sept. So perhaps late spring/early fall.
